dedupe_keys.name: f heat qgis plugin for municipal heat planning

description: F|Heat is an open software solution, built as a plugin for the QGIS geographic information system, that helps small and medium-sized municipalities in North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany, plan a sector-coupled, decarbonised energy system. It was published on Zenodo (version 0.1.1, May 2025, updated October 2025) by Hinnerk Willenbrink, Lars Goray, Philipp Sommer and Elmar Brügging. It is used for the municipal heat plans required by Germany's Heat Planning Act (Wärmeplanungsgesetz), and aims to speed up heat and energy planning with transparent principles by enabling rapid preliminary planning of supply options that can feed detailed planning and feasibility studies. Documentation is on Read the Docs, and the ZIP installs through the QGIS extensions manager. Coverage is North Rhine-Westphalia by design. The plugin is downloadable from Zenodo under GPL 3.0 or later at no cost. Caveats: it is an early version tailored to one German state's data and legal context. Simulation uses are municipal heat planning, district heating suitability screening and decarbonisation options. Related records: model-dh-economic-assessment-district-heating-potential estimates district heating potential from rasters.
